now.headline: A photo listing can still load forever - the same symptom this repair pass was written to remove, reached by a different route.
now.detail: Import two photographs, and while the second is still resizing, delete some OTHER trip (or tap a damaged trip, or restore a broken backup). decisions.question: What should happen to a trip file with no owner in it?
decisions.why: If someone exports a trip and sends it to you, the app correctly refuses it. But if that file carries no owner at all, the app adopts the whole thing as yours - and 91 of the activities inside stay quietly stamped with the other person's name, with nothing on screen saying so. Nothing leaks and nothing breaks; the app would just be telling you a trip is yours when it isn't.
options: Refuse anything that isn't provably yours
Accept it, but visibly badge the whole trip as imported from someone else
Leave it until real accounts exist in Phase 3

decisions.question: Do you want an "accept" control?
decisions.why: Copying an activity from one of your trips into another leaves it permanently badged "from a friend" - there's no button that says "yes, this is mine now." That's the safe default, but it's the kind of thing you'd notice the first time you used it. Cheap to add now; otherwise it ships with the Phase 3 accounts work.
options: Let it ship with Phase 3 accounts
